overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Set the channel name, category, slowmode, and other channel options.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Control who can see this channel and what they can do here.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Create secret URLs that external services can use to post messages into this channel.

discord_sync.title: Discord Sync
discord_sync.description: Mirror messages between this Echo channel and a Discord channel.

discord_voice_mirror.title: Discord voice mirror
discord_voice_mirror.description: Show Discord voice activity in this Echo voice channel (join happens in Discord).

forum_creator.title: Forum defaults
forum_creator.description: Default sort, tags, and posting rules for new forum threads.

format.title: Format
format.description: Slowmode, auto-delete, and other channel formatting options.

delete_channel.title: Delete channel
delete_channel.description: Permanently remove this channel and its messages.

discord_chat_sync.title: Discord chat sync
discord_chat_sync.description: Apply the same live message mirroring to every text and forum channel in a category.
